title: Black Friday: the autoscaler wants more VMs but none appear
intro: Traffic is 4x normal. The managed instance group web-mig (europe-west1) has target size 40, but only 25 instances exist and latency is climbing. No errors in the application logs.

steps.prompt: Describe the managed instance group web-mig in europe-west1 and look at its status and current actions.
expected_commands: gcloud compute instance-groups managed describe web-mig --region europe-west1
gcloud compute instance-groups managed describe web-mig --region=europe-west1
steps.fake_output:
targetSize: 40
currentActions:
  creating: 15
  none: 25
status:
  isStable: false
steps.hint: The MIG shows what it's trying to do in currentActions.

steps.prompt: 15 instances are stuck 'creating'. List the MIG's errors (web-mig, europe-west1).
expected_commands: gcloud compute instance-groups managed list-errors web-mig --region europe-west1
gcloud compute instance-groups managed list-errors web-mig --region=europe-west1
steps.fake_output:
INSTANCE_URL  ACTION  ERROR_CODE      ERROR_MESSAGE
...web-mig-x7p2  CREATING  QUOTA_EXCEEDED  Quota 'N2_CPUS' exceeded. Limit: 200.0 in region europe-west1.
...web-mig-k3d9  CREATING  QUOTA_EXCEEDED  Quota 'N2_CPUS' exceeded. Limit: 200.0 in region europe-west1.
steps.hint: list-errors shows why instance creation fails.

steps.prompt: Confirm the regional quota usage in europe-west1.
steps.hint: regions describe shows quota limits and usage.

steps.prompt: The general CPU quota has room, but the N2-family quota is full. The fastest mitigation: switch the MIG to a new template web-tmpl-e2 that uses E2 machines (already created). Set it as web-mig's template (europe-west1).
expected_commands: gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-instance-template web-mig --template web-tmpl-e2 --region europe-west1
gcloud compute instance-groups managed set-instance-template web-mig --template=web-tmpl-e2 --region=europe-west1

steps.prompt: Watch the group until it's stable: wait-until web-mig (europe-west1) is stable.
expected_commands: gcloud compute instance-groups managed wait-until web-mig --stable --region europe-west1
gcloud compute instance-groups managed wait-until web-mig --stable --region=europe-west1
steps.fake_output:
Waiting for group to become stable, current operations: creating: 15
...
Group is stable
steps.hint: wait-until --stable blocks until the MIG finishes.

resolution: Autoscaling can only use capacity that quotas allow, and when it hits a quota it fails quietly: the target size goes up, instances sit in 'creating', and the application logs show nothing, because the new servers never exist. GCP has overall quotas (CPUS) and per-machine-family quotas (N2_CPUS, C2_CPUS...), and the family quota ran out first. New instances in the group use the E2-based template, which draws on a different quota; existing N2 instances keep running until they're recycled. Request the quota increase too, but increases are reviewed and can take hours or days: exactly why capacity planning before a known peak means checking quotas weeks ahead (gcp-tutorial-009). Also add an alert on MIG errors or 'target size minus actual size', so this pages someone before latency does.
